note: Evil Mode slice 12, the Reckoning's rooms and the last room (design Part 21 sections 1 to 8). Day 1 the eighth Badge and what the eighth Leader says; day 2 the approach, one last day, and the night before; day 3 the gate, the walk (room by room, watched) and the last room. What the Hero says is assembled from the run: an opening by how they know the Boss, then what they've seen, what they came for, what you said at a fire, what they were told. Every part has a written fallback. In Regions 1 and 2 the last room ends the region, never the run. Text is data.

giovanni.regard: There's a new outfit by the coast. People like them. I've met people people like. Look at their hands, not their faces.
giovanni.dread: There's a new outfit by the coast. I meant to have them looked at. I see I've left it to a child. Don't be brave. Be quick.
giovanni.level: I've heard both. I'm giving you both. People like them, and people are frightened of them. Usually it's the same people.

answers.protector: "I'll be careful. I mean with them. Not just with me."
answers.champion-chaser: "Eight. Thanks. I've one more thing to do and then I'm coming back for the League."
answers.strategist: "Can I ask what you'd have done? In my place? ...No. Don't tell me. I'll only write it down and then do something else."
answers.bitter-challenger: "I know what they are. I've had a sandwich off one. I *know.*"
answers.enthusiast: "I've met loads of them! Most were nice! I'll tell you how it goes!"
answers.idealist: "They've a sentence on their door. I'm going to read it to them."
answers.prodigy: "My father would thank you formally. I'm just going to say thanks."
answers.underdog: "I didn't think I'd get this one. Sorry. I mean: thank you. I'm going now. Before I think about it."

eighth.baker: A local, wiping their hands at the door of {where}: "You're going up to the building. ...They frightened me once. Then they tore up the book. I don't know what to tell you, love. I've had both."

lastDay.title: One last day
lastDay.help: The Hero sits on the wall across the street. Use the in-person slot for one of these.

go.name: Tell them they can go
go.does: Anyone who wants to be somewhere else tomorrow goes tonight, paid. Those who stay chose to.
go.said: "Anyone who wants to be somewhere else tomorrow, go tonight. No hard feelings. You'll be paid." By morning, {n} peg{s} empty.

soup.name: Send soup across
soup.does: The Hero takes it from the Friend. Not from a Grunt.
soup.taken: The Friend carries it across. The Hero takes it. They eat it on the wall.
soup.left: A Grunt carries it across. The Hero doesn't touch it. It goes cold on the wall.

chair.name: Send a chair across
chair.does: A small thing. Every Grunt at a window sees it.
chair.said: A chair goes across the street. After a while the Hero sits on it. Every Grunt at a window sees.

leave.name: Leave
leave.does: Don't be there tomorrow. It's allowed. It's remembered.
leave.said: The Boss leaves by the back way. Nobody's home tomorrow.

lastDay.notNow: Only on the Reckoning's second day, at the In person beat.

night.title: The night before

bands.Devoted: {name} sits by the door they've been given. They've moved a chair to it.
bands.Easy: {name} plays cards, losing on purpose to somebody nervous.
bands.Steady: {name} writes a letter. Packs a bag and doesn't zip it.
bands.Distant: {name} stands near the back way. Not through it. Near it.

night.hot: Somebody's got a pan on. "Their mum said they'd not have eaten."
night.knock: Then the knock. Old Obadiah, from the street: "Three Bosses before you. None of them was here the night before. I thought I'd see what it looked like."
night.knockExec: Then the knock. {name}, who could have just walked in: "I'll take the last door. Don't argue."

gate.title: The gate
gate.bend: {leader} is at the gate. Not to fight. To say one thing. "{line}"
gate.bendNone: {leader} is at the gate. Says one thing, to the Hero, quietly, and goes.
gate.befriend: A Gym trainer hands the Hero a note from {leader}. There's one on the Boss's desk too. The same note: "Mind each other."
gate.buy: {leader} isn't there. They're at home with the curtains drawn. The Hero knows why.
gate.beat: {leader} is at the gate. For the Hero. "I couldn't. You can."
gate.replace: {leader} is with the Rival, who's promised to get the Gym back.
gate.warm: Locals stand along the street. They don't block it. One takes their hat off. It isn't clear to whom.
gate.shut: Locals from shut holdings walk in behind the Hero. As far as the door.
gate.detective: {name} is across the road with the notebook. "I'm not here in a professional capacity. I'd like to see how it comes out."
gate.nobody: Nobody's at the gate. Just the street.

walk.title: The walk
walk.start: Morning. The Hero gets down off the wall and comes up the road to the door.
walk.noBase: There's no base to walk. One room. A door. The Hero knocks, which nobody expected.
walk.fight: {name} fights them at the door. It's a real fight.
walk.won: {name} sits down. They're beaten. The Hero steps round them.
walk.again: {name} gets up again. "You'll have to go through me again." They do.
walk.opened: {name} had opened the door. They wouldn't look at the building.
walk.kind: {name} gives them a Potion first. "It's not fair otherwise."
walk.nobody: Nobody stopped me. I don't know if that's because they couldn't or because they were told not to.
walk.noPen: I looked for the cages. Everyone has cages. There weren't any.
walk.penOpen: The door was open. Nothing was in it. There was a list on the wall of where each one went back to.
walk.office: The last door: the Office. It isn't locked. It can't be.

exec.9: {name}, at the Office door, fights properly. Then: "Go in. Be decent. They've been decent to me."
exec.7: {name}, at the Office door, fights. Then steps aside.
exec.0: {name} steps aside from the Office door without a fight. "I'd have held this door a region ago."

wall.drawings: The Wall: children's drawings. A van. A person in an armband holding a small Pokémon. "THANK YOU." They touch one.
wall.posters: The Wall: wanted posters. Somebody's pinned them up like trophies. They read every one.
wall.both: The Wall: wanted posters, and children's drawings, pinned over each other. They look at which is higher.
wall.bare: The Wall's bare. A rota, and nothing else on it.

open.knew: "I know. I've known since the fire. I wanted to hear you say it in here."
open.told: "You told me. You didn't have to tell me."
open.lied: "You said you just worked there." Nothing else. They wait.
open.away: The room. The Wall. They look at it for a long time. Then they leave something on the desk.

awayLeaves.protector: A Berry, for your Pokémon. A note: "I came. You didn't."
awayLeaves.champion-chaser: Their eighth Badge, face down. They come back for it an hour later.
awayLeaves.strategist: The notebook. The second column's still blank.
awayLeaves.bitter-challenger: Nothing. They turn the chair over.
awayLeaves.enthusiast: A bag of sweets, one for everyone on the Roster, with names on.
awayLeaves.idealist: The sentence, corrected, on a scrap of paper.
awayLeaves.prodigy: The speech. Unread. Folded into a boat.
awayLeaves.underdog: Their tally sheet. At the top: "No. You get better."

parts.seenNone: "I walked straight in. There wasn't anything to see. That's what I'll remember."
parts.told: "Somebody told me something on the way. {told}"
parts.toldNone: "Nobody told me anything on the way. I had to look."
parts.ask: "So. What is it? I've come a long way. I'd like to hear it from you."

profit.door: "The door says 'Everything costs. We'd like to be paid.' I read your books on the way in."
profit.first: "We started because nobody was paying the people who did the work. Then we wanted paying too."
profit.held: "...Yeah. I saw. Everyone in here gets paid."
profit.not: "That's what the door says. I asked what *you* say."

cause.door: "The door says 'Something's wrong, and nobody's fixing it.'"
cause.first: "We started because something was wrong and the League said it wasn't their job."
cause.held: "...Yeah. I saw. You're fixing it. Badly. But you are."
cause.not: "That's what the door says. I asked what *you* say."

power.door: "The door says 'Somebody's going to be in charge.'"
power.first: "We started because I was tired of waiting to be let in."
power.held: "...Yeah. You are. I can see that."
power.not: "That's what the door says. I asked what *you* say."

wonder.door: "The door says 'There's a door. We'd like to see behind it.'"
wonder.first: "We started because there was something under the ground and nobody would let us look."
wonder.held: "...Yeah. I saw the maps. You really did just want to look."
wonder.not: "That's what the door says. I asked what *you* say."

belonging.first: "We started because none of us had anywhere else to go."
belonging.held: "...Yeah. I saw. The beds have names on."
belonging.not: "That's what the door says. I asked what *you* say."

spite.door: "The door says 'One person. That's all we want.'"
spite.first: "We started because of one person, and what they did, and nobody stopping them."
spite.held: "...Yeah. I saw the string on the wall. It all goes to one place."
spite.not: "That's what the door says. I asked what *you* say."

creed.name: The Creed
creed.say: You read the sentence on the door aloud.

first.name: The first day
first.say: You tell them where the team came from.
first.hero: It's new to them. "Nobody said. Not one of them. Did they not know?"

dontKnow.name: "I don't know any more."
dontKnow.hero: A long look. "Then why's it still going?" You say: "Because of them." They look at the door they came through.

forThem.name: "For them."
forThem.hero: They look at the door they came through. "The one on the second door gave me a Potion. ...Okay. That one I believe."

scheme.name: The Scheme
scheme.say: You tell them what it's for. All of it.
scheme.hero: They're the first outsider who knows.

lie.name: A lie
lie.hero: They know. They've walked the base. It's the one place a lie can't work.

ledger.name: The Ledger
ledger.hero: Both books, on the desk, open. They read, the Hero's finger on each line. They stop at the ones from their street.

pen.name: The Pen
pen.hero: Each card's got an address. They read them. They ask for a pencil, and start writing down who takes which one home.

window.name: The window
window.hero: You stand at it. They come and stand at it too. The district's lights. "That's my street." Nobody says anything for a while.

notebook.name: Their notebook
notebook.hero: You take the notebook and write in the "Why?" column, one job at a time, and they read over your shoulder.

someone.name: Someone
someone.hero: {name} comes in, and says one thing about the Boss: "{says}"

nothing.name: Nothing
nothing.hero: They wait. Then: "...Is that it? Is that all there is?" And they answer their own question, from the walk.

someone.Devoted: I'd hold any door for them. I have.
someone.Easy: They're fair. Mostly. They listen, which is more than most.
someone.Steady: It's a job. They pay on time. I've had worse.
someone.Distant: Ask me next week. I don't know any more.
someone.Leaving: I'm going home tomorrow. Ask somebody who's staying.

ask.protector: You ask what they'd do, if they were you. "Give it back. All of it. And then stay, so they know you meant it."
ask.champion-chaser: You ask what's after the League. "I don't know. I came here to find out what's after *this.*"
ask.strategist: You ask what their total came to. "Wrong. I know it's wrong. I don't know what labour costs."
ask.bitter-challenger: You ask if they're still angry. "Yes. But not at the sandwich one."
ask.enthusiast: You ask which of the team they liked best. They tell you. It isn't who you'd guess.
ask.idealist: You ask what they'd write on the door. They show you their hand. It's still half washed off.
ask.prodigy: You ask what they want. Nobody's asked them in here. "To go and look at the sea. And for that to be enough."
ask.underdog: You ask how many they've won now. "I stopped counting. You told me to get better. I did."

heroLine: "At the third fire I asked what I'd say to whoever wrote it. You told me to say: {line} So I'm saying it."
offerRefused: They say no, kindly. "Ask me again when I know more."
battleFirst: They don't wait. Their {mon} is already out.

talked.hero: "I'm still going to the League. I'm still going to tell them. I just— I'm going to tell them *all* of it."
talked.page: I didn't fight. I thought I would.

bossWon.hero: They don't say anything. They heal their {mon} first, on the Office floor, with their back to you. Then: "Next region."
bossWon.page: We fought. I lost. I'm going to keep going.

heroWon.hero: "I'm not going to tell you to stop. You wouldn't. I'm going to keep being where you are."
heroWon.page: We fought. I won. It didn't feel like I thought.

draw.hero: To {name}, not the Boss: "Thank you." To the Boss: "One of yours did that. Not you. I'm going to remember which."
draw.stepIn: {name} steps forward, between the two of you. "That's enough. You've won. Look at them. That's enough."
draw.page: Somebody stopped it. One of theirs.

window.hero: They go to the window. They watch you go. "...You *ran.*"
window.page: They went out of the window. I watched.

away.page: Nobody was home. I sat in their chair for a minute.

evening: Whoever fought's being patched up. Somebody's cooking on something. The Wall's rolled up under somebody's arm. From whoever held the hardest door: "Well. That's what one's like."

roster.talked: The Boss talked, and it held. Heart +1.
roster.bossWon: The Boss won the battle. Nerve +1, Proud +1, Kind −1.
roster.heroWon: The Hero won. The base is lost. Anyone under Loyalty 4 goes home.
roster.draw: {name} stepped in: Loyalty 10. The rest +1 or −1, by whether they've a line about the young.
roster.away: The Boss wasn't there. Everyone −1: they stood their doors for an empty room.
roster.window: The Boss went out of the window. Everyone −2; whoever held the last door −4.
roster.ledger: The Boss showed the Ledger. Books +1.
roster.pen: The Boss opened the Pen. Every Kind +2.

page.title: The File's new page
page.fire: I got there. It was them from the fire. I knew and I didn't know.
page.noFire: I got there. I'd never seen them before. They looked ordinary.
page.asked: I asked what it was for. {answer}
page.noAnswer: I asked what it was for. They didn't say.

close.protector: I'm going to keep going till it's put right.
close.champion-chaser: Eight Badges. One more thing done. Now the League.
close.enthusiast: I said goodbye to all of them. Most said it back.
close.idealist: I read them their sentence. I think they heard it.
close.prodigy: I didn't use the speech. I'm glad.
close.underdog: I'm coming back the day after. I said I would.

page.soup: The soup was good. I'm not telling Mum about the soup.

regionOver: The last room's over. {region}'s over. The Crossing comes in a later build; the run goes on.
